finalReport.rawFindings:
--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[PAY-1] Razorpay subscription can be created but DB record may never exist
File: src/app/api/razorpay/order/route.ts (L170-L320)
Evidence: The route calls razorpay.subscriptions.create(...) then immediately attempts prisma.subscription.create(...); if the DB write fails the code returns an error and does not persist any mapping or retry, while the Razorpay subscription remains live. The webhook handlers (subscription.*) look up subscriptions by razorpaySubscriptionId and simply bail if no DB record exists.
Impact: Customers can be charged by Razorpay but never get a local subscription record → paid users with no access (hard revenue loss) and manual support overhead.  
Fix: Make creation resilient: write a DB “pending” record first (with an external id/locked state) or wrap provider+DB steps in a retry/compensating flow, and implement a reconciliation job to find and import orphaned Razorpay subscriptions.

[PAY-2] Webhooks rely on placeholder order id; payments may not map to subscriptions
File: src/app/api/razorpay/order/route.ts (L300-L360) and src/app/api/razorpay/webhook/route.ts (L1200-L1270)
Evidence: When creating a subscription the code stores razorpayOrderId as a placeholder `sub_${subscription.id}` instead of any Razorpay order_id, but webhook handlers (e.g., payment.failed fallback) attempt to find subscriptions by payment.order_id => razorpayOrderId. This mismatch means webhook payment events won't find the DB row.  
Impact: payment.failed/payment.captured events can’t be linked to the subscription and will be ignored, causing missed status updates, failed retries handling, or users not granted access after payment.  
Fix: Persist actual Razorpay identifiers (order_id/payment_id/subscription_id) returned by Razorpay; update DB on verify/webhook and ensure webhook lookups use subscription_id primarily (and fall back to stored payment/order ids).

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[PAY-3] No stored webhook event idempotency / event dedupe
File: src/app/api/razorpay/webhook/route.ts (L1-L80) and prisma/schema.prisma (Subscription schema)
Evidence: The webhook verifies signatures but does not persist incoming event IDs or enforce uniqueness; schema has no webhook_events table or unique constraint for event ids. Handlers rely on state checks (billingCycleCount/status) for idempotency instead.  
Impact: Under retries/race conditions some non‑covered handlers could be processed more than once or create confusing logs/state transitions; reconciliation and audits become harder at scale.  
Fix: Persist webhook event IDs (unique constraint) and short‑circuit already-processed events before business logic executes.

[PAY-4] Webhook uses fallback 'unknown_payment_id_from_webhook' — weak reconciliation data
File: src/app/api/razorpay/webhook/route.ts (L980-L1000)
Evidence: In order.paid handler the code falls back to a literal 'unknown_payment_id_from_webhook' when payment entity is missing, then writes that into addonDetails.  
Impact: Records with bogus payment ids break reconciliation and make refunds/disputes or support lookups unreliable.  
Fix: Do not write placeholder IDs; instead fetch payment details from Razorpay API when payload lacks payment info, or defer granting until a concrete payment_id is available.

[PAY-5] No refund/dispute handling code found in repo
File: repository-wide (search: "refund") (context)
Evidence: Code search returned no refund or dispute handlers or routines to call Razorpay refunds API.  
Impact: Without automated refund/dispute flows, teams must handle these manually; at scale this leads to slow customer recovery and operational revenue leakage.  
Fix: Add server endpoints and webhook handling for refund/dispute lifecycle (call Razorpay refunds API and reconcile DB state).

--- INFO ---

[PAY-6] Razorpay SDK + subscription model exists and webhook signature validated
File: src/lib/razorpay.ts and src/app/api/razorpay/webhook/route.ts
Evidence: repo uses the razorpay SDK and the webhook verifies x-razorpay-signature with HMAC; prisma schema includes subscription/payment fields.
